question: By what kind of mantras is the supreme one liberated?
premises: Liberation is attained through mantras alone
The mantras must be declared in Śaiva scripture
inference: Therefore the supreme one is liberated by pure mantras declared in Śaiva scripture alone
uncertainties: Whether uttama is vocative address or nominative subject
plain_english: O supreme one, one is liberated only by pure mantras declared in the Śaiva scriptures.
